questions.text: Find the public document factory that constructs an empty TOMLDocument.

targets.name: document
targets.rationale: Returns a new TOMLDocument instance.

questions.text: Locate the key_value helper for parsing a single TOML key/value pair.

targets.name: key_value
targets.rationale: Constructs Parser and invokes its _parse_key_value method.

questions.text: Where is Parser._parse_array implemented?

targets.name: Parser._parse_array
targets.rationale: Collects values, whitespace and comments until the closing array bracket.

questions.text: Locate TOMLFile.read.

targets.name: TOMLFile.read
targets.rationale: Reads UTF-8 without newline translation, records line-ending style and parses the content.

questions.text: Which number parser rejects leading-zero decimal forms and signed nondecimal base prefixes?

targets.name: Parser._parse_number
targets.rationale: Returns None for disallowed leading zeros and signed hexadecimal, octal or binary prefixes.

questions.text: Where does the parser read four or eight hexadecimal digits for a Unicode escape and validate the resulting character?

targets.name: Parser._peek_unicode
targets.rationale: Selects the digit count, inspects the extracted code and attempts chr(int(...,16)) with invalid values handled.

questions.text: Which string-escape parser removes multiline continuation whitespace only when it contains a newline?

targets.name: Parser._parse_escaped_char
targets.rationale: Collects multiline whitespace, rejects it without a newline and otherwise returns an empty string.

questions.text: Which file writer preserves the detected LF or CRLF convention when serializing an edited document?

targets.name: TOMLFile.write
targets.rationale: Normalizes serialized newlines according to _linesep and writes with newline translation disabled.

questions.text: Where does parsing a standalone TOML value reject additional trailing input?

targets.name: value
targets.rationale: Parses one value and raises UnexpectedCharError if the parser has not reached the end.

questions.text: Which public function silently tolerates unregistering a custom encoder that is not registered?

targets.name: unregister_encoder
targets.rationale: Suppresses ValueError around removal from CUSTOM_ENCODERS.

questions.text: Where does conversion choose an array of tables for a sequence of dictionaries and an ordinary array for other sequences?

targets.name: item
targets.rationale: The list/tuple branch selects AoT for all-dictionary values in an eligible parent, otherwise Array.

questions.text: Which raw-string factory checks invalid sequences for the selected TOML string type before escaping?

targets.name: String.from_raw
targets.rationale: Checks type_.invalid_sequences and raises InvalidStringError before creating the String.

questions.text: Trace the public TOML parse function into the parser that builds the document body.

targets.name: parse
targets.rationale: Constructs Parser from the input and calls parse.

targets.name: Parser.parse
targets.rationale: Parses body items and tables into a TOMLDocument and finishes parsing mode.

questions.text: Which public standalone-value helper uses the parser's type-dispatch implementation?

targets.name: value
targets.rationale: Calls Parser._parse_value and requires the end of input.

targets.name: Parser._parse_value
targets.rationale: Dispatches strings, booleans, arrays, inline tables, dates and numbers based on the next character.

questions.text: Trace date construction from its public API to the RFC 3339 parsing utility.

targets.name: date
targets.rationale: Calls parse_rfc3339, verifies a date-compatible result and converts it to an item.

targets.name: parse_rfc3339
targets.rationale: Recognizes date, datetime and time strings and constructs the corresponding Python values.

questions.text: Which public string factory selects a string kind and delegates raw-value validation to the item implementation?

targets.name: string
targets.rationale: Selects the literal/multiline string type and calls String.from_raw.

targets.name: String.from_raw
targets.rationale: Validates forbidden sequences and creates the string with optional escaping.

questions.text: Trace reading a TOML file through the API wrapper to the parser entry point.

targets.name: TOMLFile.read
targets.rationale: Reads the file, detects line endings and passes its content to loads.

targets.name: loads
targets.rationale: Delegates to parse.

targets.name: parse
targets.rationale: Creates the Parser and parses the document.

questions.text: Which API serializer calls the container code that renders tables, arrays of tables and simple items in body order?

targets.name: dumps
targets.rationale: Calls as_string after converting ordinary mappings when necessary.

targets.name: Container.as_string
targets.rationale: Walks the ordered body and dispatches table, AoT and simple-item rendering.

questions.text: Where is a custom encoder registered, and where are those encoders tried when built-in item conversion cannot handle a value?

targets.name: register_encoder
targets.rationale: Appends the callable to the shared CUSTOM_ENCODERS list.

targets.name: item
targets.rationale: Tries custom encoders for unsupported values and requires them to return an Item.

questions.text: Trace raw string creation into the utility that replaces requested escape sequences.

targets.name: String.from_raw
targets.rationale: Calls escape_string when escaping is enabled for the selected string type.

targets.name: escape_string
targets.rationale: Finds configured sequences and replaces them with compact or Unicode escapes.

questions.text: Which parameterized test checks that parsing and dumping valid example files preserves their original text?

targets.name: test_original_string_and_dumped_string_are_equal
targets.rationale: Asserts each fixture's original content equals dumps(parse(content)).

questions.text: Which test verifies that editing a CRLF file retains CRLF line endings when it is written back?

targets.name: test_keep_old_eol
targets.rationale: Writes a CRLF file, edits one value through TOMLFile and checks the exact output bytes.

questions.text: Find the parameterized test rejecting adjacent or appended standalone values such as truefalse or adjacent arrays.

targets.name: test_value_rejects_values_with_appendage
targets.rationale: Passes appended-value examples to tomlkit.value and requires ParseError.

questions.text: Which test verifies that the initial LF or CRLF in a multiline basic string is omitted from the parsed value?

targets.name: test_parse_multiline_string_ignore_the_first_newline
targets.rationale: Checks both leading newline forms and expects only foo followed by a newline.
